name: Kilo — KiCad Localizer
description: Package portable design blocks and localize project footprints and 3D models.
description_full: Kilo packages reusable KiCad design blocks with their footprint and 3D-model dependencies, then installs them into other projects. It can also localize an existing project into reversible project-local libraries, with validation reports, transaction history, and restore support. New data uses Kilo identifiers while legacy KiCad BlockPack packages and project state remain readable.
